entries.title: A crewmate that needs you at another computer knows which one you are using
entries.body: When you have more than one computer or a phone connected, a crewmate now hears which one you clicked or wrote from. A card that needs you at a particular computer says which one you are using now and how to reach the other one. If you answer from a different computer than the one it needs, the crewmate says so before it starts anything that waits on you there.
entries.noPicture: Cards look the same; the change is in what a crewmate is told about where you clicked.
